notes: Company snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS — IT asset/service management platform used by ~650 employees. Internal product team owns "Scout" internal chatbot (helpdesk) currently running on rule-based flows + webhook integrations to Zendesk/Okta.

Why Redwood: looking for lower-latency, streaming-first inference + tool-calling for in-line ticket actions (lookups, escalate, password reset). They prefer starting Hosted API for speed, then Dedicated once traffic/SLAs justify it.
Quote from CTO on 2025-01-22 demo: 'Need sub-200ms first-token for password flow and <500ms for typical short answers. Streaming is non-negotiable for long KB replies.'

Security/Compliance ask: must produce immutable audit log for every agent action (who/when/prompt/response), retention controls configurable by workspace (90d, 1y, 3y). Okta SSO + SCIM already in place.

Integration notes: tool-calling prototype will call internal microservice (ticket.lookup, user.reset_password). SE raised concerns about token scoping for privileged calls — requires KMS-backed secrets and short-lived tokens.

POC scope agreed: 2-week POC (sandbox) -> measure median latency, cold-start percentiles, streaming stability, and tool-calling security. POC endpoints to mirror production routes (ticket, kb-search, password-reset).

Pricing discussion: interested in Hosted for initial months but need committed Dedicated pricing if sustained >1.5M tokens/mo. Wants explicit burst/buffer pricing and unit economics breakdown (cost/token after batching).
Operational ask: per-route observability (token breakouts), trace to originating employee id, and automated fallback to smaller model variant if latency or errors spike.
Recent activity: security questionnaire returned 2025-02-14 (SEC-1987) — needs clarifications on retention wipe procedures and region-bound storage for audit logs.

Internal note (AE): emphasize Redwood Optimize recommendations in POC — batching/caching could reduce costs 30-45% on their typical KB-heavy queries. Schedule follow-up with Solutions Eng for A/B model latency test.

Next meeting scheduled 2025-03-18: POC mid-point review. Action items: SE to deliver tool-calling auth design, AE to send Dedicated pricing scenarios, Legal to provide list of required residency attestations.
